away.summary: The Predators (9-4-5) are coming off a 3-0 win at Los Angeles on Tuesday and did not hold a morning skate. Justus Annunen is projected to start after Juuse Saros made 30 saves in the previous game. Nashville will be without scratched defensemen Nicolas Hague and Ilya Lyubushkin, plus injured forwards Jonathan Marchessault and William Trudeau.

home.summary: The Ducks (10-7-1) are one of the NHL's hottest teams, winners of five straight and riding an eight-game stretch of five-plus goals. Cutter Gauthier was named First Star of the Week after three hat tricks in five games. Troy Terry will make his season debut after recovering from June 9 hip surgery, while the Ducks returned Nico Myatovic to the AHL. Laurent Brossoit is projected to start in goal.
